column1: # name: Wi-SUN FAN channel plans by regulatory domain
# source: the list that the wisun stack held in code (regulatory domains and operating classes of the Wi-SUN FAN PHY); not confirmed against the rules of each regulator
# note: One row for each operating class of a band plan. domain is the regulatory domain value of the PHY (decimal). ranges_mhz are the usable ranges of the plan (low-high
column2: apart by spaces). Channel k of a class is centred at first_mhz + spacing_khz x k for k from 0 to channels - 1. modes lists the FSK modes of the class as bit rate in kbit/s:modulation index
column3: apart by spaces; an empty list is a class that the stack does not receive. A host sets the setting ranges of the stack to the ranges in Hz and the setting classes to the classes of the plan in class order. countries lists the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the countries that use the plan
column5: and is the same on every row of a plan; a host picks the plans of a country by it. A country can have more than one plan. WW is worldwide and has no list; EU870 has no list
column6: as the countries that open 870 to 876 MHz are not confirmed.
